connection_type: I'm an interested observer — no direct personal connection
duration: I have always cared about the welfare of others, especially those who are needing help the most.
disclosure_text: I am always looking to help others. I feel like it is doing how what Jesus would do in welcoming the stranger.
micronarrative: What stands out to me is the disconnect between the sides. I wish there was an opportunity to dialogue as that would help clear up misunderstandings. I have not really bridged a divide, but I have been able to give people some things to think about. I also think that people generally want to be kind and look out for each other. In the communities where I’ve lived, most have chosen to keep their head down and not raise a stink. It is important to note that I think people want to do the right thing. People are conservative for the most part and feel that resources are too scarce to share. I think they need to recognize that there is enough out there for all. This scarcity mindset has made me want to help even more. I feel frustrated because I am limited by the money I have to help others.
